function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the Pandora Papers public reporting concerning King Abdullah II of Jordan's alleged offshore property network. Return only evidence supported by the benchmark/source materials and preserve every source ID exactly as provided. Build a source-grounded inventory of: (1) King Abdullah II; (2) every explicitly named shell company, offshore company, trust, foundation, or other legal vehicle; (3) every explicitly named intermediary, adviser, lawyer, accountant, agent, or representative; (4) jurisdictions and corporate-registration locations; and (5) luxury real-estate locations and properties. For each reported relationship, state the direction and exact wording or a faithful close paraphrase, and classify it as documented fact, allegation, reported assessment, inference, or unresolved uncertainty. Include dates, ownership/control statements, purchase or sale statements, and explanations offered by the king's representatives only when explicitly supported. Identify contradictions, ambiguity, missing links, disputed ownership, and any claims that cannot be established from the evidence. Do not infer or invent entities, source IDs, relationships, or details. Cite source IDs inline for each material statement and finish with a compact evidence matrix mapping entities to relations and sources. The response must be usable to produce a final report that distinguishes fact from allegation and uncertainty."}
function.name: ConductResearch
